title: PathWeaver
description: Moves the expensive part of mob pathfinding — the A* search — off the server thread onto a read-only region, with a freshly-isolated finder and a per-thread path-type cache. Safe by construction; coordinates with Lithium. Alpha / work in progress.
body:
> ⚠️ **Alpha / work in progress.** Early release. The design is careful and it's unit- and soak-tested, but it has **not** been thoroughly tested across many packs and long real-world sessions yet. Keep backups and please report anything odd.

# PathWeaver

**Async mob pathfinding — safe by construction.**

PathWeaver moves the expensive part of mob pathfinding — the A\* search — off the main server thread, onto a read-only world region. It targets the single biggest steady-state server cost in a busy world (`WalkNodeEvaluator`, `PathFinder`, `PathNavigation`) **without changing how mobs behave** and **without fighting Lithium**.

> Other async mods make the game *not crash* on unsafe concurrent access. PathWeaver is safe *by construction* — the worker runs a private, freshly-built search with its own per-thread path-type cache, so it never writes shared main-thread state. Block data is read through a read-only region view (reads only, bounded by a staleness check); any error degrades cleanly to synchronous pathfinding.

## What it does NOT do (by design)
- **No async entity ticking** — that's the unsafe thing; PathWeaver deliberately avoids it.
- **No async collision.**
- **No faster node evaluation** — [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) already optimizes that; PathWeaver coordinates with it rather than competing.

## Two features (both toggleable)
- **Async pathfinding** — the A\* search runs on a bounded worker pool. Only mobs whose evaluator is an exact-match allowlisted vanilla class are eligible; everything else uses unchanged vanilla sync pathing.
- **Conservative repath elision** — reuse a live path when a requested target is within a small tolerance of the current one (default 1; `0` = vanilla exact-match).

## Safety gate
Async runs only for mobs whose `NodeEvaluator` is **exactly** `WalkNodeEvaluator`, `FlyNodeEvaluator`, or `SwimNodeEvaluator` — never a subclass. On top of that, at startup PathWeaver scans every other mod's mixins: if a mod mixes into the pathfinding classes, the affected mob family is forced back to sync. Fabric API and Lithium are trusted; unknown third-party mixins are not. Any guard hit, pool saturation, or worker failure degrades cleanly to vanilla sync — never a crash, never a stuck mob.

## Requirements
- Minecraft **26.1.x**, Fabric loader, Java **25**
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api), [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
- Server-side (dedicated servers, LAN hosts, singleplayer). Pairs well with Lithium.

## Compatibility

PathWeaver is built to coexist. When it can't safely accelerate a mob, it silently falls back to vanilla synchronous pathfinding for that mob — never a crash, never a behaviour change.

- **Coordinates with [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium).** Lithium optimizes node evaluation; PathWeaver moves the search off-thread — they complement each other.
- **Fabric API** — required and trusted.
- **Mods that touch pathfinding are auto-detected and kept safe.** At startup PathWeaver scans every other mod's mixins; any mod that mixes into the vanilla pathfinding classes forces the affected mob family back to synchronous pathing. Those mobs still work perfectly — they just don't get the async speedup.
- **No known hard incompatibilities.** Worst case for any mod is "no speedup for those mobs," not a break. Works alongside chunk/performance mods (c2me, ServerCore, etc.).

Found a mod PathWeaver misbehaves with? Please open an issue — the safe-by-default gate should catch it, and reports help tighten the scanner.
